items.title: Carmen Lundy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 15, 2023
items.q: a beautiful song by Parish and DeRose

ctx.x: I think — I have a very positive — I think the music has informed me. And creativity is a positive thing. This wonderful part of the human experience, tapping into our creativity — sometimes I wonder, without really knowing it, the artist has a wonderful perspective I

think because we come to center stage and then we play to the listener. Sometimes it only takes one person playing and suddenly the magic begins because somebody’s listening. And I wonder sometimes, because so much of my life experience has been at center stage around the world several times, that I come away with an understanding, this commonality of — cultures may be different but there’s a human condition that’s unique to all of us as people. And I wonder sometimes if I’m informed or if I can see or observe in…
Wonderful. And I did hear “A Love Supreme” as that tune faded out.
